jobs.prompt: Create premium anatomical fitness illustration master for DUMBBELL SEATED SHOULDER PRESS, exercise0405, ADULT MALE. Reference supplies approved grayscale anatomical artistic style only, not squat poses. Two equal side-by-side panels, pure white background, generous gutters and full equipment/body visible. Same adult, bench, dumbbells, clothing, camera and scale. Front-three-quarter view. Sit on a proper upright exercise bench with padded seat and backrest at about80-85degrees, pelvis and back supported, feet flat stable hip-width on ground. Panel1 press starting position: one dumbbell in each hand at shoulder/ear height, palms facing forward, elbows about90degrees, forearms nearly vertical, wrists stacked above elbows. Elbows slightly in front of shoulder frontal plane, not forced far behind. Panel2 press endpoint: BOTH dumbbells overhead with elbows comfortably extended, forearms aligned above shoulders, keep dumbbells separated, don't collide. Controlled shoulder upward rotation; back remains supported and torso upright without exaggerated lumbar arch. Highlight deltoid caps red on exposed shoulders only; other muscles grayscale. Realistic anatomical proportions with crisp HD detail and subtle shadows. Black opaque sleeveless athletic top with full torso/back coverage and suitable armholes, knee-length black shorts fully covering front sides back seat crotch, shoes. Normal seams folds closed hems; no see-through fabric, cutaways or holes. Real hand grips around dumbbell shafts, five fingers per hand, no extra limbs. No words numbers labels arrows logos. All overhead weights comfortably within upper image margins. Both figures same scale. Still positions, not animation.
